name: BusinessCustomer
description: Commercial banking aggregate root for a legal entity customer. Created by SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core) at BPH-001 as a prospect record and promoted to 'active' at BPH-007 (Account Provisioning) once a BusinessAccount is opened. This is the foundational entity consumed by all downstream commercial journeys (JRN-007, JRN-013, JRN-014, JRN-023). IMPORTANT: This entity is SEPARATE from ENT-001 (Customer, owned by CAP-001/SVC-001). Commercial Banking (CAP-002) owns BusinessCustomer; Retail Banking (CAP-001) owns Customer. There is no shared FK relationship between the two — they are independent aggregate roots in separate capability domains.

fields.name: business_customer_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable. Globally unique across the bank's commercial customer estate.

fields.name: company_number
fields.validation_rule: Required for limited companies and LLPs. 8-character UK Companies House registration number (zero-padded) or 2-letter prefix format for LLPs. Validated against Companies House API. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: legal_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. 1–200 characters. Legal registered name as returned by Companies House API. Must match CH record exactly. Sourced from BPH-002 CH verification — not from applicant self-declaration.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: limited_company | llp | partnership | sole_trader | charity | other. Determines verification path. Immutable after initial application.

fields.name: company_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: active | dormant | dissolved | liquidation | administration | other. Sourced from Companies House API at BPH-002. Updated on pKYC monitoring events.

fields.name: registered_address
fields.validation_rule: Required. Object: line1, line2 (optional), city, postcode, country_code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Sourced from Companies House API.

fields.name: trading_address
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Same structure as registered_address. Collected from applicant if different.

fields.name: incorporation_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Sourced from Companies House API. Immutable.

fields.name: sic_codes
fields.validation_rule: Required. Array of UK SIC 2007 5-digit codes. At least one code. Maximum 4 per CH registration. Used in sector risk scoring.

fields.name: email
fields.validation_rule: Required. RFC 5321. Max 254 characters. Primary business contact email.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: prospect | active | suspended | closed. prospect → active on BusinessAccountOpened (BPH-007).

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any field mutation.

relationships.description: BusinessCustomer may hold multiple BusinessAccount records.
BusinessCustomer has one or more UltimateBeneficialOwner records (MLR 2017 Regulation 5).
BusinessCustomer has one or more DirectorRecord entries.
BusinessCustomer has one BusinessKycAssessment record per CDD cycle.

design_decisions.decision: BusinessCustomer is a completely separate entity from ENT-001 (Customer). No FK relationship exists between them.
design_decisions.rationale: Commercial banking and retail banking are separate capability domains. ENT-001 is owned by CAP-001/SVC-001; ENT-079 is owned by CAP-002/SVC-005. Merging them would couple unrelated capabilities and make CDD governance unclear.

design_decisions.decision: legal_name is sourced exclusively from Companies House API, not applicant self-declaration.
design_decisions.rationale: MLR 2017 Regulation 28(11) requires company identity verification from a reliable and independent source. CH is the authoritative source.
